rawTranscript:
WEBVTT

00:00:05.000 --> 00:00:10.000
<v Jordan Blake>Let's talk hiring. Where's the backend role at?</v>

00:00:10.500 --> 00:00:16.000
<v Amira Khan>I'll send the updated job spec to the recruiter by end of day.</v>

00:00:16.500 --> 00:00:21.000
<v Jordan Blake>Good. Also, are we still doing the Friday all-hands?</v>

00:00:21.500 --> 00:00:26.000
<v Amira Khan>Actually let's drop the Friday all-hands, attendance has been low, not worth it right now.</v>

00:00:26.500 --> 00:00:31.000
<v Jordan Blake>Fine by me. One more thing, we decided last week budget stays capped at two new hires this quarter, just confirming that still stands.</v>

00:00:31.500 --> 00:00:36.000
<v Amira Khan>Yes, that's still the cap, two hires max this quarter.</v>

00:00:36.500 --> 00:00:40.000
<v Jordan Blake>Great, that's everything, thanks all.</v>
